topic: Campaign report data and formatting ownership
summary_markdown:
The conversation addressed who is responsible for campaign reporting updates. [p11] stated that they have received several points from someone regarding necessary report updates and are preparing to pass this information along.

[p6] clarified the division of labor: data questions should be directed to Alexey, while formatting issues (like changing line colors on graphs) should be addressed to [p6].
decisions: Data questions for campaign reports go to Alexey.
Formatting changes for campaign reports go to [p6].
